description: Fast, native file search engine and launcher: name search, content search, and a daemon behind both
post_install: info 'rgy: Scoop does not start the search daemon. Pick one way to keep the name index fresh:'
info '  A) daemon (resident, live change feed):  rgy-autostart install'
info '     the same action is install.ps1 -Activate (no download, re-runnable). Undo: rgy-autostart uninstall'
info '  B) one-shot snapshot (no resident process):  searchctl --root $env:USERPROFILE --reindex --count ''*'''
info '     rebuilds the index ONCE, picking up new/changed files; repeat it (or schedule it daily) to refresh.'
info '  Choose one: the daemon and a scheduled rebuild both write the same index file. See the README.'
